claims.text: CEC resolution No. 20-25 of 19 June 1991 takes note of chairman V. I. Kazakov's report on the results of the election of the President of the RSFSR, approves the text of the CEC communication on the results and orders the communication published through TASS in the republican and local press; signed by V. Kazakov (chairman) and V. Prozorov (secretary).
claims.uncertainty: The TASS publication date is not given; that publication is the 'official announcement' from which Article 1 of Law 1494-I counts one month. The archival leaf is unconfirmed: the exhibit caption gives GARF F. 10026, Op. 8, D. 204, L. 6-7 and captions the three images L. 6, L. 6 ob. and L. 7, while the handwritten folio numbers on the images read 5, 6 and 7.

claims.text: The communication approved by that resolution reports that the CEC examined the district commissions' protocols on the results of voting on 12 June 1991 in the election of the President of the RSFSR, held in 88 electoral districts, and that six candidates were on the ballot.
claims.uncertainty: The voting day as the communication states it. It is not the determination or approval of the result (19 June), not a publication date and not a term start. The communication is undated; it is dated by the resolution that approved it.

claims.text: As approved on 19 June 1991: 106,484,518 citizens were on the voter lists and 79,498,240 (74.66 per cent) took part; votes for the candidates were Yeltsin 45,552,041 (57.30 per cent), Ryzhkov 13,395,335 (16.85), Zhirinovsky 6,211,007 (7.81), Tuleev 5,417,464 (6.81), Makashov 2,969,511 (3.74) and Bakatin 2,719,757 (3.42); 1,716,757 ballots (2.16 per cent) were declared invalid.
claims.uncertainty: Result figures as determined and approved on 19 June; the vote itself took place on 12 June (ru_cec_election_voting_19910612). Votes against each candidate, ballots with every name struck out and the results annulled at two polling stations are in the communication but not imported.

claims.text: Under Article 15 of the RSFSR law on the election of the President, the communication states that Boris Nikolaevich Yeltsin, born 1931, Chairman of the RSFSR Supreme Soviet, was elected President of the RSFSR, having received more than half the votes of those who took part, and that Alexander Vladimirovich Rutskoi, chairman of a Supreme Soviet committee, is considered elected Vice-President of the RSFSR.
claims.uncertainty: An election result, not an oath or an assumption of office. Yeltsin is still described as Supreme Soviet Chairman. No holder observation starts here.

content_comparison.method: Compared the visible text of the recorded page with the 2019 captures, and viewed the three reproduced facsimiles at full size (724 x 1100 pixels) with the handwritten folio corners and the signature block enlarged.
content_comparison.exhibit_caption: Identical in every capture with a page body: resolution of the Central Electoral Commission for the Election of the President of the RSFSR 'Об итогах выборов Президента РСФСР', 19 June 1991, original, typescript, 29.6 x 21.0, GARF F. 10026, Op. 8, D. 204, L. 6-7; footer: Federal Archival Agency, 2012. Agrees with the source title, the publisher and the claim locator 'exhibit caption'.
content_comparison.image_captions: Each image caption repeats the title and date and ends 'ГА РФ. Ф. 10026. Оп. 8. Д. 204.' with 'Л. 6.', 'Л. 6об.' and 'Л. 7.' for images 1-3, as recorded in exhibit_caption_leaf (L. 6, L. 6 ob., L. 7).
content_comparison.facsimile_1: The resolution, typescript, headed with the Commission's name and 'On the results of the election of the President of the RSFSR'. Point 1 takes note of the report of the Commission's chairman, comrade V. I. Kazakov, on the results; point 2 approves the text of the Commission's communication on the results; point 3 orders the communication published through the Telegraph Agency of the Soviet Union in the republican and local press. Autograph signatures stand beside the typed names '(В.Казаков)' under 'Председатель' and '(В.Прозоров)' under 'Секретарь'. Dated '19 июня 1991 года' and numbered '№ 20-25'. Handwritten folio 5, top right.
content_comparison.facsimile_2: The communication, undated, headed 'СООБЩЕНИЕ': the Commission examined the district commissions' protocols on the results of voting on 12 June 1991; 106,484,518 citizens on the lists in 88 electoral districts; 79,498,240 took part (74.66 per cent); six candidates on the ballot; votes for Bakatin 2,719,757 (3.42), Yeltsin 45,552,041 (57.30), Zhirinovsky 6,211,007 (7.81), Makashov 2,969,511 (3.74), Ryzhkov 13,395,335 (16.85) and Tuleev 5,417,464 (6.81), with votes against each. Handwritten folio 6, top right.
content_comparison.facsimile_3: Page '2.' of the communication: 1,525,410 ballots (1.92 per cent) with every name struck out; 1,716,757 ballots (2.16 per cent) invalid; results annulled at polling station No. 389 (Leningrad regional district) and No. 1904 (Novosibirsk district); under Article 15 of the RSFSR law on the election of the President, Yeltsin Boris Nikolaevich, born 1931, Chairman of the RSFSR Supreme Soviet, elected President with more than half the votes of those who took part; Rutskoi Alexander Vladimirovich, chairman of the Supreme Soviet committee for invalids, war and labour veterans and the social protection of servicemen and their families, considered elected Vice-President. Handwritten folio 7, top right.

claims.ru_cec_resolution_20_25_19910619: Agrees in every element: number 20-25, date 19 June 1991, points 1-3 (chairman V. I. Kazakov's report taken note of, the communication text approved, publication through TASS in the republican and local press) and the two signatories with their functions. The resolution gives no publication date, as the uncertainty says.
claims.ru_cec_election_voting_19910612: Agrees: facsimile 2, opening paragraphs (voting on 12 June 1991, district protocols, 88 districts, six candidates).
claims.ru_cec_communication_results_19910619: Agrees: every figure in the claim matches facsimiles 2-3.

content_comparison.page_transcription_variances: The exhibition page's own excerpt, which no claim cites, differs from the facsimiles in wording only: it reads 'были внесены 6 кандидатов' where facsimile 2 reads 'были включены шесть кандидатов', and 'был избран' where facsimile 3 reads 'избран'; it lower-cases the Supreme Soviet title and elides Rutskoi's committee. The claims follow the facsimiles, and the English 'was elected' renders 'избран'.
content_comparison.leaf_numbers: Unresolved, and preserved exactly as recorded: the exhibit caption gives GARF F. 10026, Op. 8, D. 204, L. 6-7 and captions the three images L. 6, L. 6 ob. and L. 7, while the handwritten folio numbers on the images read 5, 6 and 7 (re-read on the reproduced images, corners enlarged). The 2019 captures carry the same captions and each image has a single capture, so the discrepancy is in the published exhibit, not introduced by an archive capture. Neither numbering is adopted; resolving it needs GARF's own file or inventory.

source_review.outcome: Reproduced: the recorded response and the three facsimiles return their recorded bytes and SHA-256 exactly, and the recorded capture remains the reproducible identity. The official host still gives no response from this environment. No claim text, date, locator or uncertainty changed.
